unit.name: record
unit.signature: export function record(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown>
unit.body: L001| return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);

note: noun/verb ambiguity: `record` reads as an imperative verb but the body is a type predicate

unit.name: inRange
unit.signature: export function inRange( value: unknown, min: number, max: number, ): value is number
unit.body:
L001| return (
L002|   typeof value === "number" &&
L003|   Number.isFinite(value) &&
L004|   value >= min &&
L005|   value <= max
L006| );

note: predicate named as an adjective phrase, no verb at all
